mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.name, b.bm_id, b.note, b.status, b.owner_id, b.deleted_at, b.created_at, b.updated_at, 'account' AS bm_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fb_account_bm ab WHERE ab.bm_id = b.id) AS account_count, 0 AS pixel_count FROM fb_bms b WHERE b.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT pb.id, pb.name, pb.bm_id, pb.note, pb.status, pb.owner_id, pb.deleted_at, pb.created_at, pb.updated_at, 'pixel' AS bm_type, 0 AS account_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fb_pixels p WHERE p.pixel_bm_id = pb.id) AS pixel_count FROM fb_pixel_bms pb WHERE pb.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND pb.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT b.*, 'account' AS bm_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fb_account_bm ab WHERE ab.bm_id = b.id) AS account_count, 0 AS pixel_count FROM fb_bms b
b.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR b.bm_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
AND b.status = #{status}
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
